infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: This app reads sleep, activity and heart rate data to understand what affects your energy, focus and recovery, and to personalize insights. You control exactly what is shared and can revoke access anytime in Settings.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: This app does not write health data.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Voice reflections let you speak instead of type. Audio is transcribed and then discarded unless you choose to save the reflection.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Used to transcribe your voice reflections into text.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Used to understand your meeting load (count and density only, not content) so insights can account for your schedule.

plugins.calendarPermission: Used to understand your meeting load (count and density only, not content) so insights can account for your schedule.
